title: Shopify Custom app access token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: missing "_" delimiter after the shpat prefix (the documented shpat_/shppa_ prefixes each include the trailing underscore). Twin of "Shopify Custom app access token and Shopify Public app access token: must be flagged (provider-documented)".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of shopify-token-shpat-plain: boundary: missing "_" delimiter after the shpat prefix (the documented shpat_/shppa_ prefixes each include the trailing underscore). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
